_comment: Records are the passport's subjects — one product, one origin story. This file IS the passport data: no chain, no dashboard, no API key. `photo` is the documentary image used on the page (hands, cloth, looms); `image` is the record sheet drawn by `npm run record:svg`, used on the passport and for print. PHOTO CAVEAT: the photos in public/imagery/ come from the design system's uploads and include AI-generated reference images — replace them with licensed community photography before publication (brief §6). Never invent figures: leave a field out rather than guessing it.

records.title: Cloth no. 0042 · Mama Ina Dida
records.subtitle: Adonara, East Nusa Tenggara · 2026
records.description: Hand-spun local cotton, dyed with indigo leaf and morinda root on a back-strap loom in Adonara. Eleven weeks on the loom, three dye baths. The motif is shown with the weaver's permission; some of what it means stays with the community.

records.title: Cloth no. 0043 · Mama Yosefina
records.subtitle: Lembata, East Nusa Tenggara · 2026
records.description: A shorter length woven in Lembata over six weeks, cotton from the community plot, finished with a warp-faced band in morinda red.

records.title: Cloth no. 0101 · Mama Klara
records.subtitle: Manggarai, East Nusa Tenggara · 2026
records.description: Woven in Manggarai over twelve weeks with indigo thread spun and dyed in the village. Recorded as part of the motif documentation for the local curriculum.

records.title: Kebun Kapas Rakyat · plot 07
records.subtitle: Community cotton plot · 2026 harvest
records.description: One season of a community cotton plot: seed, planting, harvest weight and the households the cotton went to. A shared record — up to forty people who worked the plot can hold the same passport.
